page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 80 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The CPU configuration features 80 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and network-based resources. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

The hardware profile of the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 9.6 GB per core, positioning it as a highly resource-dense option for memory-intensive workloads. Because the instance features dedicated physical cores with no hyperthreading, it offers predictable compute performance at the expense of the higher thread density found in hyperthreaded alternatives. The lack of local storage requires users to provision external block storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the storage tier selected. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of RAM relative to compute cores makes this instance suitable for workloads that require large in-memory datasets without needing proportional scaling of CPU licenses.

This instance is designed for memory-heavy enterprise applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, big data analytics, and memory-intensive electronic design automation applications.
